status: Prospective Root-only instrument benchmark; separate from the lease renewal
execution_precondition: After Main34 closes, one imported closed CTRL1 or PILOT; no concurrent import0 or other owner of the selected world
question: Does batching repeated stat/lstat/resolve for source paths already held by the original immutable deny-write cache reduce checkpoint witness overhead without changing the full witness or Native state?
prototype_scope: Only stat/lstat/resolve for already whitelisted immutable source files under Windows deny-write/delete leases, first call fresh, final physical recheck, reset finally. Other threads and all nonwhitelisted paths remain fresh.

criterion.reference: Prototype wall time compared with the faster of both baseline passes
criterion.if_not_met: No deployment; preserve the measured negative or inconclusive result

interpretation: One controlled technical comparison on one closed history; no new cognitive learning, no kernel change and no general efficiency ranking. Concurrent host load and order are recorded limits.
activation: Even a positive benchmark does not auto-install. Root must declare versioned source/code_scope migration at a closed boundary; Main live source remains untouched.
